facts.business: CWD Limited is an integrated technology company engaged in the design, development, and manufacturing of wireless communication and IoT-enabled electronic solutions for sectors including digital payments, smart metering, enterprise communication, weather monitoring, and industrial IoT.
facts.related_party_note: Related party transactions include loans taken/repaid from Meshmerise Networks Pvt Ltd (Rs 30 lakh each), loans given to Meshmerise Networks Pvt Ltd (Rs 63 lakh), interest on loans (Rs 1.43 lakh), sales to Meshmerise Networks Pvt Ltd (Rs 400 lakh), remuneration to KMPs (Tejas Kothari Rs 92.78 lakh, Siddhartha Xavier Rs 92.78 lakh, Aditya Xavier Rs 62.08 lakh), deposits given to Tejas Kothari (Rs 395.04 lakh), unsecured loans from Tejas Kothari (Rs 117.23 lakh in FY25) and Siddhartha Xavier (Rs 62.61 lakh in FY26, Rs 57.30 lakh in FY25).
